title: A finitely based finite semiring generates a variety with continuum many subvarieties
summary: This paper establishes the existence of a finitely based finite semiring whose variety contains a continuum of subvarieties; such a variety is said to be of type \(2^{\aleph_0}\). Using the homomorphism theory of Kneser graphs, we prove that the 3-element semiring \(S_{53}\) is the first known example with this property. Moreover, \(S_{53}\) belongs to the variety of the max-plus semiring \((\mathbb{N},\max,+)\), which therefore is also of type \(2^{\aleph_0}\).
